title: xDailyBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Professional Consultation for Real-Life Problems
abstract: arXiv:2609.07784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for everyday assistance, yet existing benchmarks only partially reflect the requests users naturally make in practice. Real-world requests are often open-ended, casually specified, and context-dependent, requiring models not only to follow explicit instructions but also to infer unstated needs from user background and situational context. We introduce xDailyBench, a benchmark of 248 carefully curated tasks spanning 51 scenarios across personal life, white-collar work, learning and research, and cross-domain activities. The tasks are grounded in requests that users have actually completed or genuinely intended to accomplish with AI, and are evaluated with fine-grained binary rubrics covering both explicit and implicit requirements. translated_title: xDailyBench：面向现实生活问题专业咨询的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于日常辅助，然而现有的基准测试只能部分反映用户在实践中自然提出的请求。现实世界的请求往往是开放式的、随意表述的、依赖于上下文的，这不仅要求模型遵循明确的指令，还要求模型能够从用户背景和情境上下文中推断出未言明的需求。我们提出了xDailyBench，这是一个包含248个精心策划任务的基准测试，涵盖个人生活、白领工作、学习与研究以及跨领域活动共51个场景。这些任务基于用户实际已完成或真正打算借助AI完成的请求，并通过涵盖显性和隐性需求的细粒度二元评分标准进行评估。我们在标准化的智能体设置下评估了11个前沿模型。最佳模型达到了75.6%的任务级得分，而所有模型的表现均显著……
tldr: 该论文提出了xDailyBench基准测试，基于用户真实需求构建了涵盖51个场景的248个任务，采用包含显性和隐性需求的细粒度评分标准评估大语言模型处理开放式、依赖上下文的现实生活专业咨询问题的能力，发现最佳模型的任务级得分仅为75.6%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces xDailyBench, a benchmark of 248 tasks grounded in real user requests across 51 scenarios, evaluated with fine-grained rubrics covering both explicit and implicit requirements, revealing that even the best frontier LLMs achieve only 75.6% task-level performance on open-ended, context-dependent professional consultation.
